items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A lot of people, let‘s see John Ritson came out here, he went back to New York.

ctx.x: [laughs] Well… boy. But that was a good band. Thad and Mel formed that band and they asked me, ―Snooky would you come play with this band?‖ and I said, ―Sure Thad, you know I‘m going to play with that band.‖ And when I had to leave New York and leave the band Thad and I, we just was almost in tears because I was leaving New York to go to California. I had to, you know what I‘m saying. I hated to leave that, that‘s the one thing I hated to leave in New York, other than that, I didn‘t mind leaving New York. New…
